svg.title: One evidence foundation, separate assessment views
svg.desc: Seven distinct assessment lenses reuse selected evidence through permitted retrieval, verification, interpretation, explanation and locally authorized action. Selected evidence can be reused across seven separate assessment views: ESPR/DPP, functional safety, the EU AI Act, MDR where medical scope applies, the Machinery Regulation, CRA and export controls. Each view requires its own applicability analysis, accepted evidence, authority and decision rule; the arrows do not assert that every record is relevant to every regime. The proposed workflow separates permitted retrieval, verification, interpretation, AI-assisted explanation and locally authorised action. A withdrawn source triggers review only where it supports a dependency. Reductions in repeated work, response time or cost and improvements in explanation or portability are hypotheses to measure, not observed outcomes or automatic compliance.

Selected evidence can be reused across seven separate assessment views: ESPR/DPP, functional safety, the EU AI Act, MDR where medical scope applies, the Machinery Regulation, CRA and export controls. Each view requires its own applicability analysis, accepted evidence, authority and decision rule; the arrows do not assert that every record is relevant to every regime. The proposed workflow separates permitted retrieval, verification, interpretation, AI-assisted explanation and locally authorised action. A withdrawn source triggers review only where it supports a dependency. Reductions in repeated work, response time or cost and improvements in explanation or portability are hypotheses to measure, not observed outcomes or automatic compliance.

g.text: Measure correct decisions, unsupported claims, disclosure failures, tokens, throughput, p95 response time and total lifecycle cost.

g.text: These are hypotheses for a complete controlled workflow. A graph, signature or open standard alone guarantees none of them.

g.text: Synthetic demonstration. No safety approval, legal certification, autonomous physical action or measured AI-performance improvement is reported.
